player_prompt.intro:
O tseneletse Slitherlink mo gridi ya {R}x{C}!
Tsenya loopi e le nngwe e e tswelang pele gore selo sengwe se na boketelele jwa mafelo a a neng a a lekanyeditswe.
Tsenya mafelo a ketelele ka:
  [h r c] - tsenya ketelele ya godimo ya ditshidi mo rari r, kolone c
  [v r c] - tsenya ketelele ya moja mo ditshidi mo rari r, kolone c
Dinomoro di bontsha palo e e tlhokegang ya mafelo a ketelele, '.' e raya gore ga go na molawo.
O na paka ya {max_turns} ditsela go rarabolola puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsela ya aksi e lebega e sa tlwaelesegile. Dirisanye [h row col] kgotsa [v row col].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Go nna kwa ntle ga boto.

outcome.win: O dirile sekgopi se le sengwe! Tharabololo ya thamalakane e rarabolotswe!
outcome.turn_limit: Go fitlhetswe selekanyo se o ka kgonang go tsamaya mo go sone.
